_what: game-two-audio -> game-two-assets audio handoff, batch v1 (M4b, 2026-08-18). Owner-performed in-house renders (Reaper 7.79 + owner VSTs, driven through the bridge loop; compositions authored in data/audio_listen/fixtures.json, exported as MIDI scaffolds). NO third-party audio, NO sample-pack content. These are the production source files; the sha-verified PCM16 evaluation twins live in data/audio_listen/stems/ and never ship. Consumer: the game-two-assets exports pipeline (its manifest/provenance/loudness law governs runtime files; LUFS is deliberately unmeasured here - the assets pipeline measures at ingest per music-production/game-audio-pipeline.md). Loop stems are bar-exact at 120 bpm 4/4 (bar = 96000 frames @ 48 kHz) per docs/integration-readiness.md section 4.
